The '''Trogodiles''' were sentient reptilian species. During the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], at least [[Swyy'm-Ee|one member]] of the trogodile species competed in the [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattataki]] [[The Cauldron|Arena]], where it was killed by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].

==Biology and appearances==
[[File:MBardiTrogodile.jpg|200px|left|thumb|A greige Trogodile]]
The Trogodiles were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]]<ref name="USB" /> that matched a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] physiology: their body was bilaterally symmetrical, comprizing a torso with a single head, two [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and two legs. Trogodiles possessed hands with five digits each along with clawed feet featuring three digits forward and one back.<ref name="CW" /> Like most reptiles,<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> they lacked [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. However, they did have a crest of scales that started behind the top of their heads and tapered towards the end of the neck. Their heads, which were flatish on the sides, had a wide, U-shaped snout filled with sharp [[Tooth/Legends|fangs]],<ref name="CW" /><ref name="R60" /> revealing a red interior and pale [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]] when opened.<ref name="MaE" /> Trogodiles have under bites. When the [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] was closed, some of the fangs would stick out.<ref name="CW" />

==Culture==
These predatory reptiles fought using their traditional crooked blades called [[fi'lang]].<ref name="USB" />

==Trogodiles in the galaxy==
[[File:Trog.jpg|280px|thumb|right|A Trogodile prisoners in Ventress' palace]]
Shortly after the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> at least [[Swyy'm-Ee|one Trogodile]] warrior fought in [[the Cauldron]] arena,<ref name="CW" /> the largest gladiatorial pit<ref name="DBR">{{DB|location|rattatak|Rattatak}}</ref> on the harsh<ref name="USB" /> and forsaken world of [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]],<ref name="BS">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20031119.html|text=The Blood-sport of Rattatak}}</ref> until the [[Death/Legends|death]] at the hands of [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].<ref name="CW" />

When Asajj Ventress returned to Rattatak, she imprisoned some of her opponents, including two Trogodiles, in the dungeon of [[Castle Ventress|her castle]] until [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha-17]] freed all the captives during their [[Escape from Rattatak|escape]].<ref name="R60" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="CWA-6">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 6|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume'' 6]] dates its four stories to just before and during the events of {{Film|III}}, which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> a greige Trogodile took part in a [[Riot at the M'Bardi Prison|riot]] in an [[M'Bardi Prison|underwater prison]] on the planet [[M'Bardi]], where [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] were sent to restore order.<ref name="MaE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Swyy'm-Ee|unnamed reptilian warrior]] first appeared in the [[Chapter 6 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|sixth chapter]]<ref name="CW" /> of ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'', an animated television micro-series<ref name="Chapter Archive">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/microseries/chapter/archive.html|text=View ''Clone Wars'' Chapter Archive}}</ref> produced by [[Cartoon Network]] Studios<ref name="Volume One">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Volume One|''Star Wars: Clone Wars'' Volume One]]</ref> and originally aired on [[November 14]], [[2003]].<ref name="TV">{{TVcom|url=shows/star-wars-clone-wars/chapter-vi-276612|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars - Season 1, Episode 6: Chapter VI}}</ref> The character was later identified as «Trogodile» in ''[[Ultimate Sticker Book: Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'', a sticker book written by [[Simon Beecroft]] and released in [[2004]].<ref name="DK">{{DK|url=us/9780756607593-ultimate-sticker-book-star-wars-clone-wars|text=Ultimate Sticker Book: Star Wars: Clone Wars|nolive=1}}</ref>
